description: This PHP class 'Xml' in the PhpSpreadsheet library handles reading and parsing SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML format) files, including extracting worksheet names, worksheet info, and loading spreadsheet data into PhpSpreadsheet objects.

classes.name: Xml
classes.description: A class for reading and parsing SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML) files into PhpSpreadsheet objects.

methods.name: xmlMappings
methods.description: Returns an array of style mappings for fill and border styles.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the given file is a valid SpreadsheetML file based on signature signatures.

methods.name: trySimpleXMLLoadString
methods.description: Attempts to load the file contents as a SimpleXMLElement, with security scanning.

methods.name: listWorksheetNames
methods.description: Returns an array of worksheet names from the file without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Returns info about worksheets (name, last column, total rows, etc.) without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromString
methods.description: Creates a Spreadsheet object from a string of XML contents.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Creates a Spreadsheet object from a filename.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads data from a file or string into an existing Spreadsheet object, parsing XML and setting worksheet data.

methods.name: parseCellComment
methods.description: Parses cell comments from XML and adds them to the spreadsheet.

methods.name: parseRichText
methods.description: Creates a RichText object from annotation string.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Helper to get attributes from a SimpleXMLElement, returns empty XML if null.
